program.name: Chin-up Arms
program.subject: Arms
program.blurb: Arms from the bar and the floor: chin-ups and curls, dips and presses, then a leg day.
program.about: Arms trained with the big moves first. The biceps day starts on the bar with chin-ups and chin holds, then curls. The triceps day starts with floor dips and close-grip push-ups, then extensions. The third day is legs. Bodyweight moves load the arms heavily, and the dumbbells finish them off. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
